propositions: Duplicate workflow-owned CAS delivery loops were consolidated into a single Python core module (src/rebar/_store/push.py) with push-first retry, fetch-and-merge recovery, and a five-cycle budget
The strict push entrypoint (push_tickets_branch with strict=True) raises PushDeliveryError with stable reason and unpushed-commit count; existing callers retain best-effort defaults via strict=False
The locked commit-and-push operation (commit_and_push_tickets_branch) stages, commits, and delivers workflow transactions with established bot identity and commit subject
Workflows delegate delivery exactly once through strict Python adapters; reconcile-bridge.yml and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml no longer contain their own fetch/merge/retry loops
All three child changes (pushed, locked commit-and-push, and workflow cutovers) are merged and tested with complete coverage of success, contention, and rejection paths
